title: LinkedIn introduces a "seems like AI slop" button to allow users to report posts they think are AI-generated (Joseph Cox/404 Media)
summary: Joseph Cox / 404 Media: LinkedIn introduces a “seems like AI slop” button to allow users to report posts they think are AI-generated — Following 404 Media's reporting on how LinkedIn is full of AI slop, the platform is giving users a chance to report it when they see it.
